text: No serif type anywhere: headings, prose, captions, decks are all --font-sans. IA is one sans family.
why: The site paints one family, Benton Sans; a serif reads as another firm.

text: No left-border accent cards, quotes or callouts. IA's accent line is the hairline above a we statement; otherwise a full --border hairline.
why: The left stripe is a generic template move; IA's only coloured rule runs on top.

text: No radial gradients, glows or blurred blobs painted in CSS. IA's only soft blue fields are the two image files.
why: The site has no CSS colour gradient; its atmosphere is photographic (chatbg, ia-blue-field-2).

text: No Tailwind radial gradient utilities; same rule as no-radial-gradient.
why: The site has no CSS colour gradient.

text: No conic gradients, rings or colour wheels.
why: Not in IA's vocabulary; charts are flat --chart-1 to --chart-4.

text: No frosted glass. The floating nav, the mode tabs and the chat pill are solid surfaces with a hairline, not blurred.
why: The nav reads as plain white with a border; glass is not in the capture.

text: No Tailwind backdrop-blur utilities; same rule as no-backdrop-filter.
